```{ojs}
//| echo: false

d3 = require("d3@7")

// ── DATA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

species_nodes = [
  { id: "bd", label: "B. dorsalis", type: "species", colour: "#2E7D9E" },
  { id: "cc", label: "C. capitata", type: "species", colour: "#C05C28" }
]

theme_nodes = [
  // shared
  { id: "gut",   label: "Gut Microbiota",         type: "shared",  colour: "#7B5EA7", species: ["bd","cc"] },
  { id: "gene",  label: "Gene Drives",             type: "shared",  colour: "#7B5EA7", species: ["bd","cc"] },
  { id: "eco",   label: "Ecology & Behaviour",     type: "shared",  colour: "#7B5EA7", species: ["bd","cc"] },
  // B. dorsalis only
  { id: "pest",  label: "Pest Control",            type: "bd",      colour: "#2E7D9E", species: ["bd"] },
  { id: "trans", label: "Transcriptomics",         type: "bd",      colour: "#2E7D9E", species: ["bd"] },
  // C. capitata only
  { id: "sit",   label: "SIT",                     type: "cc",      colour: "#C05C28", species: ["cc"] },
  { id: "res",   label: "Insecticide Resistance",  type: "cc",      colour: "#C05C28", species: ["cc"] },
  { id: "meth",  label: "Methods & Technology",    type: "cc",      colour: "#C05C28", species: ["cc"] },
  { id: "nutr",  label: "Nutrition & Reproduction",type: "cc",      colour: "#C05C28", species: ["cc"] },

// edges: source → target, weight = papers, papers array

    { title: "Cuticle-associated microbiota suppress fungal infection (2026)", url: "https://scijournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/ps.70704" },

    { title: "RNAi-mediated immune suppression enhances Serratia marcescens pathogenicity (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1007/s10340" },
    { title: "Novel defensin-like antimicrobial peptides as promising targets for control (2026)", url: "https://scijournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/ps.70805" },
    { title: "Chitosan nanoparticle-based nucleic acid pesticide system (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1007/s10340-025-01984-1" },
    { title: "Improving fungal biocontrol through binary strain combinations (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1002/ps.71247" },

    { title: "Attractancy potential of terpinen-4-ol and synergistic attractant effects (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jafc.6c01314" },
    { title: "Lure-and-infect strategy integrating attractants with Beauveria bassiana (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1007/s10340-026-02054-w" }

    { title: "CRISPR/Cas9-mediated genome editing in the management of B. dorsalis (2026)", url: "https://link.springer.com/protocol/10.1007/978-1-0716-4746-2_18" },
    { title: "Next-generation genetic biocontrol technologies for tephritid pests (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1080/19336934.2026.2682509" }

  { source: "bd", target: "eco",   weight: 10, papers: [

    { title: "Chemosensory and detoxification mechanisms in B. dorsalis (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.3390/insects17040416" },
    { title: "Enhanced female preference to oviposition cues by mating-induced odorant-binding proteins (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jafc.5c12985" },
    { title: "Resource competition between Z. cucurbitae and B. dorsalis (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.3390/insects17090921" },
    { title: "B. dorsalis dominance and first report of three Dacus species in Uganda (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.sciaf.2026.e03286" },
    { title: "Survey parameters to support detection survey design for B. dorsalis (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.2903/sp.efsa.2026.EN-10407" }

  { source: "bd", target: "trans", weight: 1,  papers: [
    { title: "METTL3/METTL14-mediated RNA m6A modification in male reproductive development (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/1744-7917.13510" }
  ]},

  // C. capitata
  { source: "cc", target: "gut",   weight: 6,  papers: [
    { title: "Full-length 16S rRNA gene sequencing reveals variable Medfly gut microbiome features (2026)", url: "https://academic.oup.com/ismecommun/advance-article/doi/10.1093/ismeco/ycag292/8898642" },
    { title: "Dominance of Zygosaccharomyces and shifts in bacterial pathways (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0335811" },
    { title: "Enterobacter supplement and ambient conditions determine sterile male performance (2026)", url: "https://resjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/phen.70054" },
    { title: "C. capitata microbiota and its effect on environmental stress tolerance (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/1744-7917.70010" },
    { title: "Enterobacter-based dietary supplements affect thermal response of sterile males (2026)", url: "https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/bulletin-of-entomological-research/article/enterobacterbased-dietary-supplements-in-both-larvae-and-adult-diet-affect-thermal-response-of-sterile-males/A1E682C2632276FCC5F8EE472B13DB0B" },
    { title: "Antimicrobial feeding of parental adults reduces offspring tolerance to chemical stress (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/aen.70117" }
  ]},
  { source: "cc", target: "gene",  weight: 3,  papers: [
    { title: "A novel polymerase III promoter for gene editing in C. capitata (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.21.719894" },
    { title: "Generating cisgenic sexing strains in insect pests (2026)", url: "https://www.nature.com/articles/s42003-026-09624-9" },
    { title: "DsiRNA-mediated silencing of transformer leads to masculinisation of XX embryos (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/1744-7917.70173" }
  ]},
  { source: "cc", target: "sit",   weight: 3,  papers: [
    { title: "Probiotic modulation of gut microbiota enhances immunity in SIT sterile males (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1007/s00248-026-02754-x" },
    { title: "Holobiont integrity in C. capitata enhances larval development: implications for SIT (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/aen.70063" },
    { title: "Functional validation of a white pupae minimal gene construct in C. capitata (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/1744-7917.70058" }
  ]},
  { source: "cc", target: "eco",   weight: 12, papers: [
    { title: "Thermal acclimation and environment drive field dispersal patterns (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/een.70147" },
    { title: "Analyzing C. capitata dispersal from South to Northward in Türkiye (2026)", url: "https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12600-025-01350-y" },
    { title: "Urban-agricultural interface and occurrence of Mediterranean fruit fly (2026)", url: "https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10340-025-01968-1" },
    { title: "Seasonal reinfestation of C. capitata in continental climates (2026)", url: "https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10341-026-01825-0" },
    { title: "Novel approaches for the detection of low-density Mediterranean fruit fly populations (2026)", url: "https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10530-026-03917-0" },
    { title: "Chemical profile of C. capitata from different agricultural Egyptian systems (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.21608/jpces.2026.510311.1016" },

    { title: "Horizontal and vertical transmission of Beauveria bassiana (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/eea.70144" },

    { title: "Impact of hydric stress during pupal development on adult morphology (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jinsphys.2026.104989" }

  { source: "cc", target: "res",   weight: 1,  papers: [

  ]},

    { title: "Deep learning-based classification of embryonic development stages in C. capitata (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1002/jez.b.70042" }
  ]},
  { source: "cc", target: "nutr",  weight: 2,  papers: [

  { source: "cc", target: "ento",  weight: 1,  papers: [

]

// ── NETWORK VIZ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{
  const W = width
  const H = 580

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .attr("width", W)
    .attr("height", H)
    .style("font-family", "sans-serif")
    .style("background", "var(--bs-body-bg, #f8f5f0)")
    .style("border-radius", "8px")
    .style("border", "1px solid #ddd")

  // tooltip div
  const tip = d3.select("body").append("div")
    .style("position", "fixed")
    .style("background", "#fff")
    .style("border", "1px solid #ccc")
    .style("border-radius", "6px")
    .style("padding", "10px 14px")
    .style("font-size", "12px")
    .style("max-width", "300px")
    .style("box-shadow", "0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)")
    .style("pointer-events", "none")
    .style("display", "none")
    .style("z-index", "9999")
    .style("line-height", "1.6")

  const nodes = [
    ...species_nodes.map(d => ({...d})),
    ...theme_nodes.map(d => ({...d}))
  ]

  const links = edges.map(e => ({
    ...e,
    source: nodes.find(n => n.id === e.source),
    target: nodes.find(n => n.id === e.target)
  }))

  const maxWeight = d3.max(links, d => d.weight)

  const sim = d3.forceSimulation(nodes)
    .force("link", d3.forceLink(links)
      .id(d => d.id)
      .distance(d => d.target.type === "shared" ? 160 : 130)
      .strength(0.8)
    )
    .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-400))
    .force("center", d3.forceCenter(W / 2, H / 2))
    .force("collision", d3.forceCollide().radius(d => d.type === "species" ? 48 : 36))

  // links
  const link = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(links)
    .join("line")
    .attr("stroke", d => d.target.colour)
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.45)
    .attr("stroke-width", d => 1.5 + (d.weight / maxWeight) * 6)

  // node groups
  const node = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("g")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("g")
    .style("cursor", "pointer")
    .call(d3.drag()
      .on("start", (event, d) => {
        if (!event.active) sim.alphaTarget(0.3).restart()
        d.fx = d.x; d.fy = d.y
      })
      .on("drag", (event, d) => { d.fx = event.x; d.fy = event.y })
      .on("end", (event, d) => {
        if (!event.active) sim.alphaTarget(0)
        d.fx = null; d.fy = null
      })
    )

  // circles
  node.append("circle")
    .attr("r", d => d.type === "species" ? 38 : 28)
    .attr("fill", d => d.colour)
    .attr("fill-opacity", d => d.type === "species" ? 0.95 : 0.82)
    .attr("stroke", "#fff")
    .attr("stroke-width", 2.5)

  // labels
  node.append("text")
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("dy", d => d.type === "species" ? "0.1em" : "0.35em")
    .attr("font-size", d => d.type === "species" ? "12px" : "10px")
    .attr("font-weight", d => d.type === "species" ? "700" : "500")
    .attr("fill", "#fff")
    .attr("pointer-events", "none")
    .each(function(d) {
      const words = d.label.split(" ")
      const el = d3.select(this)
      if (words.length <= 2 || d.type === "species") {
        el.text(d.label)
      } else {
        // wrap into two lines
        const mid = Math.ceil(words.length / 2)
        el.append("tspan")
          .attr("x", 0).attr("dy", "-0.6em")
          .text(words.slice(0, mid).join(" "))
        el.append("tspan")
          .attr("x", 0).attr("dy", "1.2em")
          .text(words.slice(mid).join(" "))
      }
    })

  // paper count badge on theme nodes
  node.filter(d => d.type !== "species")
    .append("text")
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("dy", "2.6em")
    .attr("font-size", "9px")
    .attr("fill", "#fff")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.8)
    .attr("pointer-events", "none")
    .text(d => {
      const count = links
        .filter(l => l.target.id === d.id || l.source.id === d.id)
        .reduce((s, l) => s + l.weight, 0)
      return `${count} paper${count !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`
    })

  // hover — show papers
  node.on("mousemove", function(event, d) {
      const relatedEdges = links.filter(l =>
        l.source.id === d.id || l.target.id === d.id
      )

      let html = `<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px;
        color:${d.colour}">${d.label}</div>`

      if (d.type === "species") {
        html += `<div style="color:#555;margin-bottom:6px">Click a theme node to see papers</div>`
        const themes = relatedEdges.map(l =>
          `· ${l.target.label} (${l.weight} papers)`
        ).join("<br>")
        html += `<div>${themes}</div>`
      } else {
        const papersBySpecies = {}
        relatedEdges.forEach(l => {
          const sp = l.source.id === "bd" ? "B. dorsalis" : "C. capitata"
          if (!papersBySpecies[sp]) papersBySpecies[sp] = l.papers
        })
        Object.entries(papersBySpecies).forEach(([sp, papers]) => {
          html += `<div style="font-weight:600;margin-top:6px;color:#444">${sp}</div>`
          html += papers.map(p =>
            p.url
              ? `· <a href="${p.url}" target="_blank" style="color:#2E7D9E;
                  text-decoration:none;font-size:11px">${p.title}</a>`
              : `· <span style="font-size:11px;color:#555">${p.title}</span>`
          ).join("<br>")
        })
      }

      tip.html(html)
        .style("display", "block")
        .style("left", (event.clientX + 14) + "px")
        .style("top", (event.clientY + 14) + "px")
    })
    .on("mouseleave", () => tip.style("display", "none"))

  // highlight on click
  node.on("click", function(event, d) {
    const connected = new Set()
    connected.add(d.id)
    links.forEach(l => {
      if (l.source.id === d.id) connected.add(l.target.id)
      if (l.target.id === d.id) connected.add(l.source.id)
    })
    node.selectAll("circle")
      .attr("fill-opacity", n => connected.has(n.id) ? 0.95 : 0.2)
    link
      .attr("stroke-opacity", l =>
        connected.has(l.source.id) && connected.has(l.target.id) ? 0.7 : 0.05
      )
  })

  // reset on background click
  svg.on("click", function(event) {
    if (event.target === this) {
      node.selectAll("circle").attr("fill-opacity", d => d.type === "species" ? 0.95 : 0.82)
      link.attr("stroke-opacity", 0.45)
    }
  })

  sim.on("tick", () => {
    link
      .attr("x1", d => d.source.x).attr("y1", d => d.source.y)
      .attr("x2", d => d.target.x).attr("y2", d => d.target.y)
    node.attr("transform", d =>
      `translate(${Math.max(40, Math.min(W-40, d.x))},${Math.max(40, Math.min(H-40, d.y))})`
    )
  })

  // legend
  const lg = svg.append("g").attr("transform", "translate(16,16)")
  const legendData = [
    { colour: "#2E7D9E", label: "B. dorsalis only" },
    { colour: "#C05C28", label: "C. capitata only" },
    { colour: "#7B5EA7", label: "Both species" }
  ]
  legendData.forEach((l, i) => {
    lg.append("circle").attr("cx", 8).attr("cy", i * 22).attr("r", 7)
      .attr("fill", l.colour).attr("fill-opacity", 0.85)
    lg.append("text").attr("x", 20).attr("y", i * 22 + 4)
      .attr("font-size", "11px").attr("fill", "#444").text(l.label)
  })
  lg.append("text").attr("x", 0).attr("y", 80)
    .attr("font-size", "10px").attr("fill", "#888")
    .text("Hover = papers · Click = highlight · Drag nodes")

  yield svg.node()
}
```
